description: Source code implementing a no-operation version of PyInterpreterVTable and disarm method, related to Python interpreter integration in PyTorch.

classes.name: NoopPyInterpreterVTable
classes.description: A final class inheriting from PyInterpreterVTable that provides no-op implementations for interpreter methods, used as a placeholder when the interpreter is unloaded.

methods.name: disarm
methods.description: Sets the vtable of PyInterpreter to a static no-op vtable, effectively disarming the interpreter.
